decisions.description:
Decides whether the opportunity's own account should be offered as a practice, or stripped out so only its children are.
Rules are evaluated in order.
1. Practice Level - the account is explicitly marked Account_Level__c = Practice, so it IS the practice. Keep it; there are no children to offer and stripping it would leave the practice list empty. 2. New Sales - the historic rule. A New Sales opp is assumed to sit on a corporate parent, so remove that parent and offer only its children. Default - keep everything, as before.
Rule 1 is deliberately first and deliberately tests for Practice rather than not-Corporate: while Account_Level__c is blank it never matches and behaviour is identical to before the field existed. Classifying an account is what enables the new path.

Flow.description:
Main opportunity screen - add practices, labs, close opp.
2026-08-19: BN (INC3-11) - Repeaters no longer drop the last row. The Products and Labs save buttons now use c:flowDelayedNavigationButtonV3, which lets the focused input commit before the flow navigates away. - Each Opportunity Product is reset before upsert and the PricebookEntry loop runs to exhaustion, so field values no longer bleed between repeater rows. - Changing the Product on an existing row deletes the old Opportunity Product and inserts a replacement, because Product2Id and PricebookEntryId are not updateable. Description, Service Date, Reconciliation Period and Original Asset are carried across the recreate. Removed-row deletes now run after the repeater loop, immediately before the upsert. - Saving from the Labs or Products tab returns the rep to that tab. The Overview edit buttons previously stored a blank Flow Start Stage and sent them back to Overview. - Removed the Get Corporate Account lookup. It re-queried the Opportunity's own Account, so Set Account Fields reads recordId.Account directly. 2026-09-15: AP - Removed the three "Missing before close" chips (missingPhoneNote/missingEmailNote/missingShippingNote) from the close screen per user feedback that they clutter the UI. No enforcement change - the same three fields are still genuinely required once Closed Won is picked, and Require_Account_Phone_CW/Require_Portal_Admin_Email_CW/Require_Shipping_Address_CW still backstop non-screen edits. 2026-09-15: AP - closePhone now gets an inline 10-digit format check (screen validationRule, blank still passes); closeClinicalEmail relabeled to "Clinical Email (email to log into the portal)" for clarity. Pure UX fixes, no logic otherwise touched. 2026-10-16: AP - OPS-436: Update_Stage_Close_Reasons now assigns the Commitment Structure picked on the close screen to Opportunity.Commitment_Structure__c (new formula commitmentStructureToSave) so Update_Opp saves it. Previously the screen value was never written. Nothing removed. 2026-10-16: AP: Save Type is now visible for Retention only (the Expansion condition was removed from its visibility rule). Update_Stage_Close_Reasons assigns Type from new formula typeToSave, which keeps the opportunity's current Type when Save Type is hidden, so Expansion opportunities keep New Scanner, Scanner Upgrade or Exchange at close. Retention behavior unchanged.

variables.description: Deliberately never assigned, so it always reads as null. Same trick as emptyOpProd above, for text. Queue_Product_Swap assigns this to oliIdForUpsert to blank the record Id, which makes the upsert insert that row instead of updating it.
